IMPF.description: Moving Load Impact Factor (IMPF). Assigned per element key; ITEMS holds one entry per lane, whose fields depend on FACT_TYPE (impact factor / user effective span length / auto effective span length with element type).

ITEMS.description: List of impact-factor definitions for this element key. Each item targets a lane (LANE_TYPE + LANE_NAME) and specifies how the factor is determined via FACT_TYPE.

ID.description: Serial number of the impact-factor item within this element key.

LANE_TYPE.description: Lane type. Case-insensitive. LINE = line lane (LANE_NAME must match an existing line-lane name), SURFACE = surface lane (LANE_NAME must match an existing surface-lane name).

LANE_NAME.description: Name of the lane. Must reference an existing line-lane (when LANE_TYPE=LINE) or surface-lane (when LANE_TYPE=SURFACE); otherwise the request is rejected.

FACT_TYPE.description: How the impact factor is determined. Case-insensitive. IMPACT_FACT = user impact factor (uses FACTOR), EFF_SPAN_LEN_USER = user effective span length (uses FACTOR), EFF_SPAN_LEN_AUTO = auto effective span length (uses ELEMTYPE, PARTS, COMPONENTS).

FACTOR.description: [FACT_TYPE=IMPACT_FACT] impact factor value; [FACT_TYPE=EFF_SPAN_LEN_USER] user-defined effective span length. Ignored when FACT_TYPE=EFF_SPAN_LEN_AUTO.

ELEMTYPE.description: [FACT_TYPE=EFF_SPAN_LEN_AUTO] element type used for auto effective span length. Case-insensitive. TRUSS uses 0 parts / 2 components, BEAM uses 5 parts / 6 components, PLATE uses 5 parts / 8 components.

PARTS.description: [FACT_TYPE=EFF_SPAN_LEN_AUTO] part on/off flags. BEAM: [i, 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, j] (5 used); PLATE: [cent, i, j, k, l] (5 used); TRUSS uses none. Fixed length 5.

COMPONENTS.description: [FACT_TYPE=EFF_SPAN_LEN_AUTO] component on/off flags. TRUSS: [Max, Min] (2 used); BEAM: [My_max, My_min, Mz_max, Mz_min, Fx_max, Fx_min] (6 used); PLATE: [Mxx_max, Mxx_min, Myy_max, Myy_min, Fxx_max, Fxx_min, Fyy_max, Fyy_min] (8 used). Fixed length 8.
